fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Greater Miami public finance and proposed bond issues (including discussion of a convention hall), criticism of the Miami Chamber of Commerce, and a column on rent increases anticipated for November 1. Local government items include discussion of Miami Beach city management and a notice about Justice of the Peace H. W. Penney’s residence and jurisdiction. The issue also contains extensive sports coverage and commentary on boxing (including the Dempsey–Tunney fight and local fight cards), along with recurring humor/features such as “Little Geraldine,” letters to the editor, and substantial advertising.
